label: Employee relations casework
learning_outcome: Handle employee inquiries, complaints, and low-risk employee relations issues using documented guidance, investigation basics, and clear escalation criteria.
rationale: Employee relations appears across coordinator, generalist, and business-partner postings in the sample, from frontline inquiry response to investigation support, making it the most transferable capability to build first.
uncertainty: Case mix, volume, and the boundary between low-risk handling and formal investigation are not observable from the excerpts.
evidence_rationale: The recorded demand for responding to employee inquiries, questions, and complaints is the casework this priority teaches.

label: HRIS administration
learning_outcome: Configure and maintain Workday Core HCM, keep employee records current, process HR transactions, and work an HRIS support queue.
rationale: HRIS work anchors a dedicated analyst posting and recurs in coordinator and business-partner postings that name Workday specifically, so system fluency is directly exercised on the job.
uncertainty: Workday is the only platform named in the sample; other employers may run different HRIS products.
search_terms: Configure and maintain Workday Core HCM
Maintain our HRIS for all employee life-cycle processes
evidence_rationale: Workday configuration and HRIS life-cycle record maintenance recorded in postings is exactly the system administration this priority covers.

label: Performance management
learning_outcome: Guide managers and employees through performance management processes for low-risk cases and connect them to core HR functions.
rationale: Performance management is named alongside employee relations as a core supported function in generalist and business-partner postings, so it pairs naturally with ER skill building.
uncertainty: Excerpts do not show whether the role owns full performance cycles or only supports managers in defined steps.
search_terms: performance management, and other core HR functions
evidence_rationale: Postings asking for performance management support among core HR functions match this priority's manager-guidance outcome.

label: Employee lifecycle administration
learning_outcome: Run onboarding, internal transfers, promotions, exit interviews, and related recordkeeping for the full employee lifecycle.
rationale: Lifecycle administration appears in coordinator and generalist postings through explicit onboarding ownership and lifecycle process maintenance, forming the operational base of generalist work.
uncertainty: Benefits, leave, and unemployment-claim duties appear only as short skill tags, so their depth in the role is unclear.
evidence_rationale: Onboarding, transfer, promotion, and exit processing demand maps directly to the lifecycle administration this priority targets.

label: HR policy and employment law compliance
learning_outcome: Apply employment legislation and HR policy frameworks when advising managers and answering employee questions.
rationale: Postings reference compliance content and HR policy frameworks, and the O*NET foundation lists interpreting HR policies, procedures, and laws among core tasks, so policy fluency underpins defensible generalist advice.
uncertainty: Postings reference policy and legislation broadly without showing jurisdiction-specific depth or certification requirements.
search_terms: human resources policies, programs, and processes
evidence_rationale: Demand for guidance on HR policies, programs, and processes grounds the policy and employment-law advising outcome.

learning_outcome: Coach and influence director-and-above leaders, operating as a key business partner on people decisions.
rationale: Business-partner postings in the sample expect independent coaching of senior leaders, which is the advancement path from generalist operational work.

evidence_rationale: Postings requiring coaching and influencing Director- and VP-level leaders evidence the strategic business-partnering skill this priority builds.
